pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.4: yatheva mayaṃ sappajāpatikā ekanāvāya kīḷāma evamevime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvāya kīḷantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhissantīti. athakho ge bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. athakho bhagavā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.14.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca sāketā sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.3: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.5: na bhagini kappati bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.6: tumhe vā paṭhamaṃ uttaratha mayaṃ vā uttarissāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.9: athakho tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pacchā uttarantīnaṃ corā acchindiṃsu ceva dūsesuñca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.10: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.13: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave tiriyantaraṇāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyantaraṇāya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.10: abhirūhāma bhagini abhirūhāma ayya abhirūhāma ayya abhirūhāma bhagini ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā abhirūhāmāti saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.11: bhikkhuniyā abhirūḷhe bhikkhu abhirūhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.12: bhikkhusmiṃ abhirūḷhe bhikkhunī abhirūhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.20: kukkuṭasampāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.21: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.1: saṃvidahite saṃvidahitasaññī ekanāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyantaraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.2: saṃvidahite vematiko ekanāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyantaraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.3: saṃvidahite asaṃvidahitasaññī ekanāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyantaraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati bhikkhunī na saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
